title: Quinoa Delight Bowl
description: A healthy and flavorful quinoa bowl with toasted velvet and delight toppings.
instructions: 1. Rinse the quinoa in a fine-mesh strainer and drain well.
2. In a medium saucepan, bring 2 cups of water to a boil.
3. Add the quinoa and reduce heat to low. Cover and simmer for 15-20 minutes.
4. In a small bowl, whisk together the olive oil, salt, and black pepper.
5. Cut the velvet into small cubes and toss with the olive oil mixture.
6. Toast the velvet in a non-stick skillet over medium heat for 5-7 minutes.
7. Fluff the cooked quinoa with a fork and stir in the delight.
8. To assemble the bowls, place a scoop of quinoa on each plate, top with toasted velvet, and garnish with chopped fresh herbs if desired.
10. Refrigerate or freeze leftovers for later.
